artifact: Campaign 16 Phase E — frozen pre-repair anchor-omission inventory

derivedFrom.note: This inventory reproduces the frozen governing Phase E Stage-0 population artifact. It is NOT an independent re-derivation from current live bank bytes. Independent live re-derivation is the mandatory pre-repair preflight and is implemented in preflight-verify.ts.

generation.materializationNote: frozen-inventory.jsonl is produced by running the deterministic builder above rather than being transcribed by a model. Retyping 451 structured rows through a model is the corruption mode AGENTS.md forbids for bank-shaped JSON, so the builder plus a pinned digest is the tamper-evident form. The pinned SHA-256 was computed by the authoring seat from the generated bytes; preflight-verify.ts re-checks it before any repair proceeds.
generation.determinism: Pure function of the frozen source. Two runs must be byte-identical.

sortOrder: stage0QueueIndex ascending (the frozen Stage-0 deterministic order)

affectedPopulationDefinition.predicate: question.itemType === 'case_study' AND (caseStudy.stages ?? []).length > 0 AND NOT(part.answerableAfterStageId !== undefined AND stageIdSet.has(part.answerableAfterStageId)) AND NOT(part.stageId !== undefined AND stageIdSet.has(part.stageId))
excluded: strict-only 'missingRequiredAnchor' findings (renderer still gates correctly through legacy stageId)
affectedPopulationDefinition.boundaryNote: The Phase E Stage-0 measurement separately recorded 75 strict-only missingRequiredAnchor findings and 0 unresolved findings. Those 75 are a different population, are not non-closing, and are out of scope for this inventory and for the repair it supports.

precisionOfTheNumber451.statement: 451 affected stage-reference rows across 93 parent case studies, in 4 of the 13 bundled banks.
precisionOfTheNumber451.rowsAreNotParents: 451 counts embedded parts, not cases. 87 of the 93 parents contribute more than one affected row.
precisionOfTheNumber451.fullyAffectedParents: 81 parents have every declared part affected; those cases carry no sibling exemplar of a correctly anchored part.
precisionOfTheNumber451.partiallyAffectedParents: 12 parents have at least one sibling part that DOES resolve an anchor. Those siblings are in-case evidence of authoring intent and are the strongest available signal for anchor selection, but they are NOT a deterministic derivation: no live contract establishes that embedded-question order implies a monotonic nondecreasing anchor progression, so a sibling-bounded row still requires semantic review.
precisionOfTheNumber451.reconciliation: Phase A independently measured 451/93 and the Phase E Stage-0 rebuild reproduced 451/93 with zero additions and zero removals against the July identity roster.

verifiedProperties.attestation: Computed by the authoring seat over the complete frozen source; all passed.
verifiedProperties.duplicatesPreservedNotCollapsed: Multiple affected rows under one parent are retained as separate rows. parentAffectedRowCount records the multiplicity explicitly so no evidence is deduplicated away.

uniformProperties.whatThisProves: Population membership and post-repair structural closure are fully deterministic: every row is a pure omission, so the fix is the presence of a resolving anchor and nothing else.
uniformProperties.whatThisDoesNotProve: It does not make selection of the CORRECT stage anchor semantic-free. Choosing which declared stage a part should be answerable after is a content judgement wherever structured relationships do not settle it unambiguously.

inheritedPreRepairFingerprints.attestation: RECORDED, NOT RECOMPUTED IN THIS SESSION
inheritedPreRepairFingerprints.reason: The authoring seat's filesystem connector refuses text reads above 2 MiB and truncates above 300,000 characters. banks/gpt-canonical.json (6,904,978 B) and banks/gemini-canonical.json (3,767,625 B) were unreadable, and no hashing tool was reachable.
inheritedPreRepairFingerprints.pinningScope: All 13 bundled banks are pinned, not only the 4 carrying affected rows. The 9 unaffected banks are the control surface: they must match byte-for-byte in BOTH preflight and post-repair, which is what proves the repair stayed inside its authorized files.

hashSemantics.preflight: all 13 must equal the frozen values
hashSemantics.postRepair: the 9 unaffected must still equal the frozen values; the 4 affected are expected to differ and their post-repair digests are recorded in the commission evidence, governed by the work order's structural unintended-change proof rather than by a hash comparison

laterRecordedVerification.claim: R3 opening pass recorded all 13 bundled-bank hashes matching Phase E Stage 0 on 2026-09-05.

corroboratingFilesystemMetadata.note: Owner-supplied from a second repository connector. Corroborates that the relevant banks appear unchanged since the Phase E freeze. It is NOT a cryptographic substitute and it is NOT a claim that the working tree is clean relative to HEAD — git status still shows pre-existing bank modifications ('MM banks/gpt-canonical.json', ' M banks/hard-cases-canonical.json') carried from earlier Campaign 16 phases.

inheritedPreRepairFingerprints.mandatoryDischarge: preflight-verify.ts recomputes every bank digest from live bytes. In PREFLIGHT it fails closed on any of the 13 mismatching; in POST-REPAIR it fails closed on any of the 9 unaffected mismatching and records the 4 affected digests instead. No repair mutation is authorized until PREFLIGHT passes on a shell-capable seat.

residualReconciliation.queueIndicesAbsentReason: Both were sampled into the Stage-2 checker set and are the two rows that breached the §9.4 no-leak gate, so neither is part of the unadjudicated residual.
residualReconciliation.perRowStage2CoverageOmissionReason: checker-adjudication.jsonl is 427,937 bytes and exceeds this seat's 300,000-character read ceiling. Per-row Stage-2 coverage was left unstamped rather than partially inferred from a truncated read. It is not required by the repair invariant, which applies uniformly to all 451 rows regardless of adjudication status.

repairPackets.partitionRule: Parents taken in order of first appearance in the frozen queue; a packet never spans two banks and never splits a parent case; ordinary packets hold at most 20 rows.

rowSchema.rowKey: sha256('phase-e-anchor-omission-row|<bankPath>|<parentCaseId>|<partId>') truncated to 16 hex chars; stable partition and exception-queue key
rowSchema.stage0QueueIndex: ordinal in the frozen Phase E Stage-0 queue; the canonical cross-artifact join key
rowSchema.partId: embedded part id; globally unique across bundled banks
rowSchema.casePath: JSON path of the parent case in the bank at freeze time (index-based, informational only)
rowSchema.partPath: JSON path of the part at freeze time (index-based, informational only)
rowSchema.partOrdinal: 1-based position of the part within its case
rowSchema.casePartCount: declared part count of the parent case
rowSchema.parentAffectedRowCount: how many parts of this parent are in the affected population
rowSchema.parentFullyAffected: true when every declared part of the parent is affected
rowSchema.declaredStageIds: authored caseStudy.stages[].id in authored order; the closed domain of legal anchor values for this row

pathStabilityWarning: casePath and partPath are index-based and were captured at the Phase E freeze. They are informational. All mutation targeting must use the stable { id } selector on parentCaseId and partId, never an array index.
boundaries: Forensic inventory only. It contains no semantic verdict, no LEAK / NO-LEAK / COMPLETE / NONANSWER classification, and no proposed anchor value.
Membership here is a mechanical fail-open condition under a ratified renderer behaviour (DECISIONS.md P23). It is not evidence that any row leaks an answer.
No prior semantic label was read, altered, or re-interpreted in building this artifact.
This artifact authorizes no bank mutation.
